name: Solomon's Law
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Shadowhide Pendants to Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, adventurer. By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
narrative.requestItemsText: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
